facts.business: Mahanagar Gas Limited is one of India's leading City Gas Distribution companies, supplying Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) and Piped Natural Gas (PNG) to homes, businesses, industries and mobility across its operating areas.

capacity_or_capex.item: Investment in Mahanagar LNG Private Limited (MLPL)
Investment in International Battery Company India Private Limited (IBC India)
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Expected to mature in approximately 4 to 5 years

guidance_or_targets.statement: Plan to rollout five LNG stations initially, followed by four stations annually
New business investments are strategic long-term growth initiatives expected to take approximately 4 to 5 years to mature and generate significant returns

key_risks: Quality of components and supply chain constraints (for EV/battery ventures)
Dependence on GAIL for natural gas procurement (85.27% of consolidated turnover)
facts.related_party_note: The Company purchases a substantial requirement of natural gas from GAIL. It purchases domestic gas through Government allocation for CNG and Domestic PNG customers, and SPOT RLNG through board-approved competitive bidding. The Company has entered into and will enter into various agreements with GAIL for procurement and transportation of natural gas, including Transportation Charges (Capex & Opex), Remuneration (Secondment Charges - MD & DMD), Capital Expenses including Security Deposit, Opex Charges, and Employee Training. The proposed transactions with GAIL constitute 85.27% of MGL's annual consolidated turnover for FY 2025-26 (Consolidated turnover: Rs 9,065.26 Crore).
